text: {"reply":"Hello Brian. I checked your account, and I have not booked the inspection yet. Your Kestrel shows as owned, with no lease end date, so I can't confirm a lease return. I also can't see a shop supplies line on invoice RO-327743. It shows labour of 2.9 hours at $165 per hour and parts of $131.05. The total is $688.79 CAD with taxes included. My colleague's earlier message was wrong to say the charge would be removed. Only the service manager can change an invoice. I am passing your dispute to them, with the lease question, so a person can review both and contact you. They will check the $840 amount and the lease details.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Customer Brian Watson (verified via RO-327743) disputes an $840 'shop supplies' charge and wants it removed.
